title_candidates: OpenAI says agent work is moving beyond engineers
summary: OpenAI's Codex usage paper says non-developers are using agents for longer, cross-functional work. The practical move is to choose agent tasks by duration and reviewability.

primary_source.title: How agents are transforming work
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI published an Economic Research paper on Codex and agentic work.
OpenAI says agentic AI changes work from single interactions to delegated, long-horizon tasks.
The paper reports that many Codex users ask for work estimated to take more than 30 minutes or one hour of human time.
OpenAI says non-developer adoption grew quickly and that non-technical departments at OpenAI use Codex for adjacent technical work.

prerequisites: Access to a coding or work agent
One task you can safely delegate

steps.instruction: Pick one task that would take you 30 to 90 minutes, not a five-second question.
Write the desired outcome, inputs, constraints, and what the agent should not change.
Ask the agent to produce a plan before doing the work.
Approve only the first small step and inspect the result.
Scale up only if the task is reviewable, reversible, and easier to check than to do from scratch.
